payload.purpose_context: Epic #186 brings all Charter Pack content into the service's domain model. This mission (#191) adds the mission step contract kind: the service reads every step contract a pack carries, holds it as a domain artifact and writes it back unchanged in meaning, so the whole-pack round-trip gate turns this kind from expected red to green. It round-trips only what the pinned packs carry; gate-binding semantics and promotion to a full served kind stay with their own issues.
payload.purpose_tldr: Every mission step contract in the pinned Charter Packs is read into the service's domain and written back with its meaning intact.
